new_findings.severity: P1: elastic spinning impacts, including tested moderate gameplay rates
new_findings.disposition: Consistent adaptive midpoint/Cayley trajectories, same-configuration relaxation and chronological arrival response repair the original two-second energy-gain cases. Original retained executable reproduces 31.845%; candidate peak gain 0.0000203%, zero holds. Independent rotation, impact timing, momentum, curved meshes, cold-process saves and consumer tests pass on Linux. No damping, energy clamp or cutoff retune. Long-run dissipation, extreme-spin phase error and bounded-arrival limits remain documented; Windows/Android and human acceptance are pending. Operator human accepted and promoted exact c76e92dc; this does not certify universal elasticity or future corrections.

new_findings.severity: P1: free-body external acceleration retimed relative to counter-impulses
new_findings.disposition: Exact accepted SDK qualification reproduced wheel settling failures on GCC13/GCC15. Balanced public-kick negative controls expose unintended free flight. Preserve chronological CCD while restoring unconstrained pre-step kick timing; both original wheel checks and all 29 affected follow-up invocations pass. No damping or budget changes.
